entries.subject: Cassini ISS frames, 2018 shape release and radial elevation
entries.finding: [PDS calibrated Cassini ISS](https://pds-rings.seti.org/cassini/iss/calibration.html) frames, the [2018 shape release and controlled camera table](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/cassini/saturn_satellite_shape_models_V1_0/document/calypso_document.pdf) and shape-derived radial elevation supply the delivered views.

entries.subject: Additional RED/GRN/BL1 sequence
entries.finding: N1644754728_1, N1644755236_1 and N1644754662_1 were acquired and trialed. Estimated color coverage rose only from about 21.7% to 22.2%, with a conspicuous brightness boundary. The native sequence is not rejected, but the marginal gain was not promoted and its relative registration still needs qualification.
entries.revisitWhen: Further controlled registration and a source-backed explanation of the brightness boundary justify the added footprint, or another sequence supplies more useful coverage.

entries.subject: Selected calibrated Cassini filter-color observations
entries.finding: RED N1644757030_1, GRN N1644756997_1 and BL1 N1644756505_1 supply the retained False color view using the original PDS camera rows. The sequence spans changing phase and roughly nine minutes; it has no colorimetric transform or independent feature refinement.

entries.subject: Legacy Voyager/Stooke maps and shaded-relief illustrations
entries.finding: The retained source review did not select these as observed maps: they lack the combination of Cassini detail and measured camera registration used by this package. Shaded-relief drawings are not observational textures.
entries.revisitWhen: A registered observational map supplies useful independent coverage or detail on this source frame.

entries.subject: Cassini small-moon spectra and integrated photometry
entries.finding: The examined small-inner-satellite spectra and photometric analyses inform interpretation but are disk-integrated. They do not support painting a spatial composition texture onto this moon.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved, calibrated spectrum or mapped product is tied to this moon’s surface coordinates.

entries.subject: Cassini clear frames N1644754629_1 and N1644754942_1
entries.finding: The retained close-encounter extension adds the two published-camera views westward of the earlier selection. N1506184171_1 still supplies the coarse far side; emission beyond 70 degrees is withheld to prevent single pixels stretching into long strips.

entries.subject: Independent refinement of the retained filter cameras
entries.finding: The recorded fixed-camera diagnostic did not find the six independent feature patches required for refinement or an independent feature check. The released PDS camera-table registration remains the source basis; no camera was fitted by this failed diagnostic.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent interior controls can qualify a refinement without weakening the existing criteria or replacing the published frame.
